description: This file implements an Android activity that displays a compass UI using sensor data from the device's orientation sensor. It defines the Compass class extending GraphicsActivity, manages sensor registration, and renders a directional wedge that rotates according to sensor input.

classes.name: Compass
classes.description: Main activity that displays a compass using device orientation sensor data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor management, creates the custom view, and sets it as the content view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listener when activity stops.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View subclass that renders the compass graphic which rotates based on sensor data.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that creates the wedge-shaped path used in drawing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the compass, rotating based on sensor data if available.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Starts animation when view is attached.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Stops animation when view is detached.
